source_admission: Paper finds most risk-adjusted alpha in the short leg; test only avoidance of weak stocks, not a top-decile long-only alpha claim.
local_adaptation: Full historical CSI500 universe from the existing frozen DE predictions; no historical market-cap bottom-30% filter is available.
factor: daily adjusted total-return gross divided by close/open intraday gross; compound eleven complete months under the 12-2 convention
example: For January 2024 executions use January-November 2023 prices; skip December 2023.
factor_data_quality: >=80% valid sessions in each formation month; >=80% of first-signal-day universe has a factor
monthly_universe: freeze at first available decision whose next execution session belongs to that month
mutation: deprioritize weakest 10% of scorable names below every normal DE score; existing excluded holdings exit under unchanged Drop2 cap
missing_factor_rule: keep original DE score; factor expresses no opinion
development_gate: 2024 and 2025 net positive; average exposure >=90%; improve both worst-year return and net annualized return versus same-date DE control
no_feedback_rule: No 2026 values are used in development. Any later exact frozen diagnostic cannot select new variants or be claimed as sealed validation.
